forwarding_rules.description: List of port redirection rules. Each rule specifies how to forward traffic from a local address/port to a remote address/port.

comment.description: Optional comment describing the rule (will appear as # comment in config)

protocol.description: Protocol to forward. Must be 'tcp' or 'udp'. Defaults to 'tcp'.

bind_addr.description: Local IP address or hostname to bind to (use '*' for all interfaces)

connect_addr.description: Remote IP address or hostname to forward traffic to. If omitted, defaults to bind_addr.

connect_port.description: Remote port to forward traffic to (1–65535)
